title: Geologic Map of the Shirley Quadrangle, Hampton County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2012, Geologic Map of the Shirley Quadrangle, Hampton County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-200, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; map face is noise. Units are grouped by terrace (Holocene, Ladson, Penholoway, Wicomico) and the Marietta unit; group assignment from headings is flagged inferred. Symbols QPphr, QPwsr, QPwr and QPmf inferred from placement; the Ladson flood plain unit and Holocene units have no legible symbol. Brooks and others (2001) is listed in references but not cited in the text read. Bodies of standing water skipped.
SUBSURFACE: page 1 has no cross section; the explanation shows an SCGS drill hole symbol with example number 25-113 (legend only; logs on file at SCGS, not printed). Holocene sediments generally below 10 feet at their landward margin (page 1). Vertical datum not stated; base map 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 5 feet.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map face is noise). Units grouped by terrace (Holocene, Ladson, Penholoway, Wicomico) and the Marietta unit as before (group from headings inferred); map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile. Holocene sediments generally below 10 ft at their landward margin: recorded as a stated top at that margin (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (25-1xx) are plotted on the map face by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS), so none is recorded. Brooks and others (2001) is listed in references but not cited in the text. Bodies of standing water and legend-only symbols not recorded.
